# Feature request

## The problem

<!-- What is missing or hard today? Describe the situation you are in, not the solution you have in mind. -->

## The proposal

<!-- What you would like to happen. A rules change should state the mechanic, when it triggers and what it resolves. -->

## Why this way

<!-- Alternatives you considered, and why yours is better. For balance or rules questions, what measurement would settle it? -->

## Impact on the project

- [ ] Rules change (engine + specification)
- [ ] Theme content (cards, identities, factions, certification questions)
- [ ] Balance (thresholds, pass rates, position spread)
- [ ] Tooling / gate chain
- [ ] Physical track (printables, rules book)
- [ ] Documentation only

<!-- If the change touches gates, thresholds or the engine, a batch is required — see CONTRIBUTING.md §5. -->

## Compatibility

<!-- Does this break existing save/seed reproducibility, published balance baselines, or the digital/physical parity contract? -->

## Prior art

<!-- Related issues, discussions, or external references. -->

## Checklist for the reporter

- [ ] I searched existing issues and discussions for the same idea
- [ ] I described the problem before the solution
- [ ] I am willing to help test or implement the change
